# eon_finding_exclusions (Data Source)

Retrieves a list of finding exclusions in the Eon project. Every filter is optional; filters you set are combined with `AND`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# All finding exclusions in the project
data "eon_finding_exclusions" "all" {}

# Only account-wide malware exclusions
data "eon_finding_exclusions" "account_wide_malware" {
  account_wide = true
  detectors    = ["MALWARE"]
}

output "finding_exclusion_ids" {
  value = [for exclusion in data.eon_finding_exclusions.all.finding_exclusions : exclusion.id]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `account_wide` (Boolean) When `true`, only return exclusions that apply to every resource in the account. When `false`, only return exclusions scoped to a single resource.
- `detectors` (List of String) Only return exclusions for these detectors. Supported values: `RANSOMWARE_BEHAVIOR`, `DATA_ANOMALY`, `MALWARE`.
- `resource_ids` (List of String) Only return exclusions scoped to one of these Eon-assigned resource IDs.
- `types` (List of String) Only return exclusions of these types. Supported values: `PATH`, `TABLE`, `DATABASE`.
- `value_contains` (List of String) Only return exclusions whose `value` contains one of these substrings.

### Read-Only

- `finding_exclusions` (Attributes List) List of finding exclusions. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--finding_exclusions))

<a id="nestedatt--finding_exclusions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `finding_exclusions`

Read-Only:

- `detector` (String) Detector whose findings the exclusion suppresses. Possible values: `RANSOMWARE_BEHAVIOR`, `DATA_ANOMALY`, `MALWARE`.
- `id` (String) Eon-assigned ID of the finding exclusion.
- `resource_id` (String) Eon-assigned ID of the resource the exclusion applies to. Null when the exclusion applies to every resource in the account.
- `type` (String) What the exclusion refers to. Possible values: `PATH`, `TABLE`, `DATABASE`.
- `updated_at` (String) When the exclusion was created or last updated, in RFC 3339 format.
- `value` (String) What the exclusion matches: a path prefix for `PATH`, or the exact name for `TABLE` and `DATABASE`.
